description: Production-dependency advisories that cannot be patched yet. Every entry must carry a written reason and an expiry no more than 90 days away; scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs fails when an entry is expired, malformed, or past that horizon. Remove an entry as soon as the finding is fixed or the package leaves the production tree.

entries.reason: Build/CLI only, never shipped: the path is @prisma/client -> optional prisma CLI -> @prisma/config, which merges prisma.config.ts while the CLI runs. The generated runtime client does not import it, and no request-controlled object reaches the merge. The fix is deepmerge-ts 8 (a major) inside a Prisma 6.19.3 tree that pins 7.1.5 exactly; take it with the Prisma upgrade instead of forcing a major override here.
